title: khinchin-fast: Khinchin's constant to 2,000,000 certified decimal digits
description: Rigorously certified computation of Khinchin's constant using an accelerated Bailey-Borwein-Crandall zeta series over FLINT/Arb ball arithmetic with OpenMP. Includes the 2,000,000-digit result computed on August 27, 2026 (8 h 47 m on a 24-thread desktop machine) - as far as the authors can find, the largest computation of the constant on record; its first 1,000,000 digits were verified digit-for-digit against Carles Simó's independent 2016 computation cached on OEIS A002210. The repository also carries reference implementations of the same accelerated series in seventeen further languages, all verified byte-identical to the C program's output.
